Royal Decree N° 20, Table A, category IV, V, VI, VII, excepted:
- breast milk 
- less than 85% standardized or skimmed milk in 0403 9091- 0403 9099
- jam, fruit jelly, marmalade etc. in 2007
- unfermented fruit and vegetable juices in 2009
- goods offered for sale as food for dogs, cats, caged birds such as parrots and songbirds, for aquarium fish, for hamsters, guinea pigs and other small pets in 1001 1900, 1001 9900, 1002 9000, 1003 9000, 1004 9000, 1005 9000, 1006 1030-1006 4000, ...

entries.comment: Foodstuffs for human and animal consumption, live animals, seeds, plants, additives normally intended for use in the preparation of foodstuffs; products normally used to supplement foodstuffs or as a substitute for foodstuffs. Excl. beverages and water, this does not apply to selected drinks (milk and liquid milk products, plant-based milk alternatives, even if they contain added sugar or other sweetener, additive or other food, provided they retain the essential character of such beverages).

Food for human consumption, excluding food supplied for catering, is taxed at 0% (exempt with credit).

(1) 0101.10.10.00; 0106.11.00.00; 0106.12.00.00; 0106.19.90.00; 0106.20.00.00; 0106.31.00.00; 0106.32.00.00; 0106.39.90.00; 0106.90.00.00
